Data.title: Employed Residents Aged 15 Years and Over by Usual Mode of Transport to Work, Monthly Household Employment Income and Sex
Data.footnote:
Notes: Data exclude employed persons who were full-time students or overseas for at least 6 months. Full-time students are covered in the tables on usual transport to school.Household employment income includes employer/platform operator CPF contributions.Data has been rounded to the nearest 100 and may not add up due to rounding.
‘ - ’ denotes Nil or negligible. Users are advised to exercise caution when drawing inferences from survey estimates with small sample sizes or those denoted as ‘ - ’, as these estimates are based on a sample survey and subject to sampling variability. For more information, refer to the write up on the GHS 2025 Sample Design and Sampling Variability (https://go.gov.sg/ghs2025-sample-design-and-variability).
